description: Aomi Labs builds the execution harness for onchain finance. Its Task API lets wallet-controlled agents pay 0.01 USDC to prepare and simulate an onchain plan, inspect a seller-attested preview for free, then buy the frozen unsigned transaction bundle for 3% of simulated gross outgoing USDC. The buyer's wallet signs and broadcasts; Aomi never holds keys or funds.

intents.name: build_task
intents.description: Pay 0.01 USDC to prepare, inspect its simulation and price, then purchase the frozen artifact for 3% of simulated gross outgoing USDC, rounded up to micro-USDC. No transaction execution is included.

aomi.authentication: No TaskAuthorization. Gateway payment proves payer identity; private retrieval tokens grant job access. Bearer credentials are rejected.
aomi.payment_flow: Pay preparation by retrying the same request, poll the returned status URL for free, then separately pay the result URL with the private token. Payment does not authorize execution.
aomi.pricing: 0.01 USDC preparation attempt + 3% of simulated gross outgoing USDC; the signed quote is authoritative.
aomi.verification: Fetch and trust this deployment's public JWKS over HTTPS before verifying seller attestations. Never trust a key supplied by a quote. Discovery is not payment or execution verification.
